name: BLR Flight Info Team
description: A small sequential team that routes a user request and then resolves it using either flight-status or airport-service knowledge.

members.when: After classifying whether the request is about a flight, an airport service, or a general support topic.
When the request is about a specific flight number, delay, route, terminal, or gate.
When the request is about airport facilities, passenger assistance, contacts, or terminal-based services.
